description: Double-click a .curt file and it opens in the offline Curt Viewer - a browser page that renders the conversation locally. No server, no network.
notes: Scoop only unpacks the package - it does NOT register the .curt file association.
To register the handler (current user only, no admin):
CurtViewer.exe resolves its siblings (curtopen.ps1, viewer/) relative to its own
directory, so the scoop shim (which invokes the exe in place) works correctly.
Do not move CurtViewer.exe out of the package directory.
